rules.name: rrr-data-items-evidence-cfs
rules.sql: SELECT trim(client_code) AS client_code, client_status, counterparty_parent, client_name, region, trade_category, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp, legacy_id, encode(convert_to(coalesce(counterparty_parent, ''), 'UTF8'), 'hex') AS counterparty_parent_hex FROM opera.client_master_data WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND trim(client_code) IN ('AAC', 'AAI', 'AAL', 'AST', 'BCG', 'COP', 'CPS', 'CPT', 'DBG', 'DCS', 'DFI', 'EXP', 'IPP', 'JBC', 'LIT', 'MSF', 'NTG', 'NTS', 'SLC', 'SMT', 'SND', 'TER', 'VIT', 'ZMI') ORDER BY client_code

SELECT trim(client_code) AS client_code, client_status, counterparty_parent, client_name, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp, encode(convert_to(coalesce(counterparty_parent, ''), 'UTF8'), 'hex') AS counterparty_parent_hex FROM opera_backup_04_10.client_master_data WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND trim(client_code) IN ('AAC', 'AAI', 'AAL', 'AST', 'BCG', 'COP', 'CPS', 'CPT', 'DBG', 'DCS', 'DFI', 'EXP', 'IPP', 'JBC', 'LIT', 'MSF', 'NTG', 'NTS', 'SLC', 'SMT', 'SND', 'TER', 'VIT', 'ZMI') ORDER BY client_code

SELECT TRIM(client_code) AS client_code, client_status, counterparty_parent, client_name, HEX(counterparty_parent) AS counterparty_parent_hex_in_legacy_charset, CHARSET(counterparty_parent) AS value_charset, CHAR_LENGTH(counterparty_parent) AS chars, LENGTH(counterparty_parent) AS bytes FROM dbsystemuat.client_master_data_cfs WHERE TRIM(client_code) IN ('AAC', 'AAI', 'AAL', 'AST', 'BCG', 'COP', 'CPS', 'CPT', 'DBG', 'DCS', 'DFI', 'EXP', 'IPP', 'JBC', 'LIT', 'MSF', 'NTG', 'NTS', 'SLC', 'SMT', 'SND', 'TER', 'VIT', 'ZMI') ORDER BY client_code

SELECT client_status, updated_by, CAST(updated_timestamp AS date) AS updated_day, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM opera.client_master_data WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY n_rows DESC LIMIT 40
SELECT client_status, COUNT(*) AS n_rows FROM dbsystemuat.client_master_data_cfs GROUP BY client_status ORDER BY n_rows DESC
SELECT * FROM dbsystemuat.client_master_data_cfs WHERE TRIM(client_code) IN ('AAE', 'MFA', 'BUE')

SELECT client_code, client_name, counterparty_parent, version_no, version_created_by, version_timestamp, version_comments FROM dbsystemuat.client_master_data_audit_table_cfs WHERE TRIM(client_code) IN ('AAE', 'MFA', 'BUE') ORDER BY client_code, version_no

SELECT business_unit, trim(client_code) AS client_code, client_status, counterparty_parent, created_by, created_timestamp FROM opera.client_master_data WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND trim(client_code) IN ('AAE', 'MFA', 'BUE') ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT m.currency, m.spot AS spot_in_mapping, u.underlying_id AS id_in_underlying_values, COUNT(*) AS n_underlying_rows FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table m JOIN opera.underlying_settle_value_table u ON u.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND lower(u.underlying_id) = lower(m.spot) WHERE m.tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND u.value_date = :valueDate AND u.underlying_id <> m.spot GROUP BY 1, 2, 3 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 50
SELECT currency, spot, quantotype FROM dbsystemuat.currency_spot_mapping_table ORDER BY currency

SELECT currency, spot, quantotype, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.currency_spot_mapping_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) ORDER BY currency

SELECT LOWER(TRIM(contract_number)) AS contract_number, settle_date, value_date, mtm_post_dripping_today, mtm_post_dripping_today_USD AS mtm_post_dripping_today_usd FROM dbsystemuat.client_dripping_table_cfs WHERE settle_date = :cob ORDER BY 1

SELECT lower(trim(contract_number)) AS contract_number, value_date, mtm_post_dripping_today, mtm_post_dripping_today_usd, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera_backup_04_10.client_dripping_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate ORDER BY 1

SELECT lower(trim(contract_number)) AS contract_number, value_date, mtm_post_dripping_today, mtm_post_dripping_today_usd, created_by, created_timestamp, updated_by, updated_timestamp FROM opera.client_dripping_table WHERE tenant_id = (SELECT tenant_id FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) AND business_unit = :bu AND value_date = :valueDate ORDER BY 1
